contact-offices.description: T57 is a global SaaS platform for food trade. The pilot starts in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye, and any business can join online from anywhere.

cap-hire-expert.title: Hire a Food & Agriculture Expert | T57
cap-hire-expert.description: Hire verified agronomists, inspectors, food scientists and packaging experts by the job, with prices agreed up front, escrow payment and ratings, on T57.

platform-trade-cycle.title: One Trade, Every Step: Food Trade on One Record | T57
platform-trade-cycle.description: Agree a price, ship, insure, finance, pay and clear customs for any food on one platform, with verified parties, competing lenders and milestone-based finance.

platform-domestic.title: Domestic B2B Food Trade | Factory to Shop, Direct | T57
platform-domestic.description: Local factories and farms sell direct to supermarkets, restaurants and offices at factory price, by the carton, with local delivery and pay-later partners.

partners-research.title: Research & University Partners | T57
partners-research.description: T57 works with agricultural universities and research institutes to bring research to farmers, train local AI, pilot new tech and reward scientists.

partners-country.title: Country Partner Franchise | Bring T57 Home | T57
partners-country.description: Run T57 in your country or city as a licensed country partner. You build the local network; T57 provides the platform, brand and support.

about-journey.title: Our Journey: Agreements, Partnerships and Keynotes | T57
about-journey.description: The T57 timeline since 2023: the IOFS agreements, MoUs with governments and development banks, 150 MoUs at Gulfood 2026 and keynotes from Cape Town to Yinchuan.
